## ReallocationComputeOptions interface

Options for computing vault reallocations via the public allocator.

Extends [PublicAllocatorOptions](./morpho-sdk.publicallocatoroptions.md) with supply-side utilization targets that determine when reallocation is triggered.

```typescript
export interface ReallocationComputeOptions extends PublicAllocatorOptions
```
